description: This file implements the handling of remote command streaming protocols (V1 to V4) for Kubernetes, including stream creation, protocol negotiation, and terminal resize handling.

classes.name: connectionContext
classes.description: Holds the streams and connection info for a remote command session.

classes.name: v4ProtocolHandler
classes.description: Handles V4 protocol stream setup, supports terminal resizing.

classes.name: v3ProtocolHandler
classes.description: Handles V3 protocol stream setup, supports terminal resizing.

classes.name: v2ProtocolHandler
classes.description: Handles V2 protocol stream setup, does not support terminal resizing.

classes.name: v1ProtocolHandler
classes.description: Handles V1 protocol stream setup, does not support terminal resizing.

methods.name: waitForStreams
methods.description: Waits for expected streams or timeout, returning connection context.

methods.name: supportsTerminalResizing
methods.description: Indicates if protocol supports terminal resizing.

methods.name: waitStreamReply
methods.description: Waits for stream reply to be sent or stop signal.

methods.name: handleResizeEvents
methods.description: Handles terminal resize events from stream.

methods.name: v1WriteStatusFunc
methods.description: Creates a function to write status errors to stream.

methods.name: v4WriteStatusFunc
methods.description: Creates a function to marshal and write status errors as JSON.
